District dossier: bronze standing figure on a stone pedestal
Lascar Catargiu statue added as a landmark (9282891)

improvements: The Lascar Catargiu statue stands on its mapped plinth outline as a stepped stone base, a slim shaft and a simplified bronze figure; the traffic island around it is kept clear of tree crowns.
remainingGaps: All heights are estimates (shaft to 5.2 m, figure to about 8.7 m). The figure is a cylinder, a box and a sphere, not a likeness. The registry declares no replacement source id.
Sculptor, date and reinstallation year in the source comment (Antonin Mercie, 1907, 2011) were not re-verified for this record.
